title: The Pleiades Reflection Nebula I: calibrated wide-field optical photometry
publisher: American Astronomical Society; author offprint at Western Kentucky University

evidence.locator: Section 3.4, Figures 7–9; 5 × 1.7 degree BJ mosaic, centered at 4,400 Å. General nebula: 22.1–22.9 B mag/arcsec²; surrounding structures: 24.2–25.4; near 1 degree: 25.0. Common sky-zero uncertainty: 25.6 mag/arcsec². Regional ranges, not matched apertures.

statements.text: Steven J. Gibson and Kenneth H. Nordsieck (2003). Optical data constrain brightness only, never dust geometry or local texture.
